query_text: Where can I download the latest version of Python?

message.content:
You can download the latest version of Python from the **official Python website**. Here are the key details:

## Official Download Source

The primary and most reliable source is:
- **https://www.python.org/downloads/**

This page automatically detects your operating system and provides the appropriate installer. As of the latest information, Python 3.14.5 is the current stable release, with Python 3.15.0 in beta.

## Platform-Specific Options

### Windows
- Visit **https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/** for Windows-specific releases
- You can download the traditional installer (executable .exe file) or use the **Python Install Manager** from the Microsoft Store for automatic updates
- Choose between 32-bit, 64-bit, or ARM64 installers based on your system

### macOS
- Visit **https://www.python.org/downloads/macos/** for macOS-specific releases
- Download the `.pkg` installer (look for the "universal2" installer which supports both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs)

### Linux
- Most Linux distributions include Python in their package managers
- Alternatively, you can download the source code from the official downloads page and build from source

## Alternative Sources Mentioned

- **Microsoft Store** (Windows): Search for "Python Install Manager" for integrated Windows app management with automatic updates
- **Package managers**: Homebrew (macOS), apt/dnf/pacman (Linux)

## Important Tips

- Always use the official **python.org** installer for maximum reliability and security
- Make sure to check "Add Python to PATH" during Windows installation
- The traditional Windows installer is deprecated since Python 3.14 and will not be produced for Python 3.16 or later

Sources:
1. https://www.python.org/
2. https://www.python.org/downloads/
3. https://wiki.python.org/moin/BeginnersGuide/Download
4. https://realpython.com/installing-python/
5. https://www.python.org/getit/windows/
6. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/download-and-install-python-3-latest-version/
